caption: $\sin\pi = 0$
mpmath.note: The exact value is 0 and ours answers 0 (so does every other entry of a list). mpmath computes at 30 digits, so its π, its Bernoulli numbers or its terms are rounded and the result is noise of order 1e-31 (scaled by the argument): the same input at 60 digits gives order 1e-61. Noise against an exact 0 is not a value, and the comparison is relative to the answer's size, so a 0 can't agree with it.
rust.note: The double π is not π: the function of it is about 1e-16 (or a huge finite number at a pole), not the exact value; the lane compares relative to the answer's size, so a zero can't agree.
